description: Open source desktop app for open-weight models, with parallel sessions, scheduled tasks, flexible model choice, and imports from other coding agents
pre_install: abort 'Cline is running, so ~/.cline cannot be copied into Scoop persist safely. Quit Cline (including its tray icon), then run the install again.'
if ($code -ge 8) { warn "robocopy exit $code while copying '$legacy' to '$target'; compare the two directories before relying on the new location." } else { info "Copied '$legacy' to '$target'." }
pre_uninstall: warn 'Cline is running, so the state was not mirrored back to ~/.cline. Quit it and uninstall again if you want that safety copy.'

if ($code -ge 8) { warn "robocopy exit $code while mirroring '$data' back to '$legacy'." } else { info "Mirrored '$data' back to '$legacy': scoop removes CLINE_DIR on uninstall and Cline falls back to that path." }
notes: Cline's data directory (sessions, settings, provider credentials, connectors, logs) is redirected to '$persist_dir\.cline' through the CLINE_DIR environment variable, so it lives in Scoop's persist directory and survives updates.
Kanban-style session logs are redirected to '$persist_dir\.cline\apps\kanban' through CLINE_KANBAN_DATA_DIR, matching the layout Cline uses under ~/.cline by default.
The Tauri WebView2 profile (Local Storage, caches) stays in '%LOCALAPPDATA%\bot.cline.app' and cannot be redirected; it lives outside Scoop, survives updates and is not removed on uninstall.
CLINE_DIR and CLINE_KANBAN_DATA_DIR are USER-level environment variables, so any other Cline surface (CLI/SDK) that honors them also uses this data directory.
The app ships its own Tauri updater, which installs a separate copy under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Cline; prefer 'scoop update cline-desktop' so the install and this manifest stay in sync.
